projects.title: A Piece of Joy
projects.description:
Proper Pizza is a business that deals with the production, sale and distribution of the most beloved and popular pizzas to the public. 

To increase their presence in the market and to have a better image before the public they came to us. 

Fueled by our shared passion for pizza, we embarked on a journey that yielded nothing but delicious results. 

We designed gluten-free pizza packaging and other pizza packaging that made the pizza even tastier without even opening the package. 

Also, we managed their social networks, coming up with very interesting and creative content.
